report.raw_text: the text on the dashboard cards runs off the side and covers up the buttons so you can't click them. only happens on some of the cards, i think the ones with longer titles. we had a client in on friday and it did it in front of them which was embarrassing. can you make the boxes wider

hypotheses.rationale: Client's words map to this code.

repro_attempts.reasoning: Fails with exactly the behaviour the client described.

patch.unified_diff:
--- a/dashboard/summary.py
+++ b/dashboard/summary.py
@@
-    cut = text.find(" ", limit)
+    cut = limit - 1
patch.rationale: Cut at the limit. Fixes the overflow.

fix_attempts.reasoning: Repro test green but test_words_are_never_cut_in_half now fails. Rejected.

patch.unified_diff:
--- a/dashboard/summary.py
+++ b/dashboard/summary.py
@@
-    cut = text.find(" ", limit)
+    cut = text.rfind(" ", 0, limit - len(ELLIPSIS) + 1)
patch.rationale: Cut at the last boundary before the limit, hard-cut when there is none.

fix_attempts.reasoning: Repro test green and all six pre-existing tests green.

handover.client_reply: We reproduced what you described and fixed it.
